name: Bauernhof Lechnerbauer
beschreibung: The Bauernhof Lechnerbauer in Ebbs is a traditional agricultural farm. The accommodation includes holiday apartments and guest rooms with views of the mountains. The farm emphasizes organic farming and regional cycles. Guests can pet animals and experience everyday farm life. The location in Ebbs offers quick access to the center of Kufstein and the Kaisergebirge. In winter, ski areas such as Skiwelt Wilder Kaiser-Brixental are easily reachable. The quiet surroundings guarantee relaxation away from mass tourism. Regional products are served for breakfast.
